Over time, the bird learns to associate the word with the food, responding to the word as if it were the food itself. Slang terms might not be associated with rewards, so the bird may ignore them. This is a simplified explanation, but it gives you an idea of how classical conditioning can work with animals like parrots. If you'd like more details, feel free to ask!
